name: THE PROLOGUE
description: The story begins when the heavenly realms are attacked by the Great Giant Nilarudraka, who seeks to conquer the heavens. A great battle ensues between the gods and the giants, and the outcome cannot be undone. After a long battle, the gods are ultimately defeated by the Great Giant Nilarudraka.

name: THE PROPHECY
description: After the defeat, the god sought Bhagawan Wrespati to foresee the one who could defeat the giant. The prophecy revealed that the one destined to vanquish the giant was the son of Lord Shiva, who had an elephant head.

name: THE INTRUDER
description: It turns out that Lord Shiva is still meditating on Mount Kailasa, and no god or mortal dares to interrupt him. So, the gods send Lord Semara to provoke Lord Shiva. Lord Semara shoots Lord Shiva with the "Panah Asmara" (Arrow of Love), and the arrow strikes Lord Shiva's chest. Angered, Lord Shiva awakens, kills Lord Semara, and turns him into ashes, unaware of the truth.

name: THE SACRIFICE
description: The death of Lord Semara causes his wife, Lady Ratih, to mourn in sorrow. As a sign of her love and loyalty, Lady Ratih begs Lord Shiva to burn her as well, so she can share the same fate as her husband. Lord Shiva grants her wish.

name: THE TRUTH
description: As the arrow shot was the "Panah Asmara," Lord Shiva couldn't help but feel a longing for his wife, Lady Uma. They finally reunited to share their love. A few days later, while walking on Mount Kailasa, Lady Uma noticed a pile of ashes. She asked Lord Shiva about it, and after Lord Shiva explained, Lady Uma begged him to bring Lord Semara and Lady Ratih back to life.

name: THE FAITH
description: Finally, Lord Shiva granted his wife's wish on one condition: Lord Semara and Lady Ratih could not live in the heavenly realms. Instead, Lord Shiva spread their ashes into the "Mayapada Realms" (Mortal Realms), with the intention that all living souls would feel the sense of love within their souls, "Purusa & Predana."

This facial combines gentle exfoliation, firming massage techniques, and nutrient-rich serums to improve skin texture, enhance elasticity, and soften the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.

name: Anti-Aging Dry Facial (60 min)
description: A nourishing treatment specially designed for dry and dehydrated skin. This facial gently exfoliates surface cells, deeply hydrates, and replenishes lost moisture to restore softness and elasticity.

name: Asian Head Massage (60 min)
description: A holistic therapy blending traditional Asian massage with modern scalp science. Deep cleansing and a hydrating cream treatment combined with rhythmic acupressure stimulate hair growth and induce a state of profound clarity.

name: Aromatherapy Massage (60 min)
description: An ancient therapy designed to help the body get rid of toxins as soon as possible. An holistic healing treatment that combines the therapeutic power of essential oils with the physical benefits of massage therapy.

name: Foot Massage (60 min)
description: A rewarding treatment that positively impacts your entire body. Performed using the hands, foot massage effectively stimulates the reflex areas in the foot, helping to relax the whole body, leaving you with a rejuvenated energy to bring to your day.

name: DEWI PARWATI Package (180 min)
description: Known by many other names, Dewi Parwati is the gentle and nurturing form of the Supreme Hindu Goddess, Adi Parashakti (Shivashakti). Mostly seen as a mindful and delicate form of mother, she is the goddess of fertility, love, marriage and adherence with divine quality and supremacy.

name: DEWI LAKSHMI Package (150 min)
description: In Hinduism, Lakshmi, also called Mahalakshmi, is the goddess of happiness, loyalty, sincerity, goodness, eternity, life, beauty and peace. The companion and life partner of Dewa Wisnu.

name: DEWI RUKMINI Package (120 min)
description: Most praised for her beauty, good virtue and her immense love, Dewi Rukmini is known as a form of Goddess Lakshmi, the companion and life partner of Lord Krishna.

name: DEWI SRI Package (90 min)
description: Dewi Sri is the Goddess of the earth and known as the Goddess of rice and prosperity. The Balinese worship Dewi Sri as a motherly figure and have embodied the Goddess in their culture through the generations.

name: Men’s Renewal Package (90 min)
description: An invigorating spa experience created to restore balance and vitality. Combining relaxation techniques with therapeutic touch, this treatment melts stress, eases tension, and renews the body and mind.

name: Art of Body Treatment for Kids (45 min)
description: Indulge your little ones in a day of pampering with a specially crafted spa treatment for kids at The Spa. Gentle techniques help promote calm, support healthy development, and provide a peaceful, nurturing experience.

name: Deep Tissue Massage (60 min)
description: A type of massage therapy that focuses on realigning deeper layers of muscles and connective tissue surrounding muscles with firm pressure and slow strokes to reach deeper layers of muscle and fascia. It is especially helpful for chronic aches and pains and contracted areas such as stiff neck and upper back, low back pain, leg muscle tightness, and sore shoulders.

name: Warm Oil Massage (60 min)
description: An ancient therapy designed to help the body get rid of toxins as soon as possible. During the treatment, the therapist applies warm oil to apply pressure at certain points on the body for a relaxing and nourishing massage.

name: Tension Relief Massage (60 min)
description: This treatment focuses on neck, shoulder and head, along with lower back, and spine areas. As the best-known type of bodywork performed today, one of the primary goals of the tension relief technique is to relax the entire body.

name: Traditional Balinese Massage (60 min)
description: This treatment is crafted to pamper the body, mind and spirits. The palm stroke movement of traditional Balinese massage employs age old techniques including stretching, long strokes, kneading and firm applications of pressure to release tension and enhance the flexibility by incorporating aromatic massage oil.

name: Traditional Balinese Facial (60 min)
description: A Journey into traditional Balinese beauty. Using cooling herbs and rhythmic massage, this facial restores moisture and vitality to tired skin using the organic local ingredients with face acupressure.

description: Sanctum is a range of certified organic, cruelty free, natural facial products from Australia. A perfect fresh lift for your skin. We begin with a cleanse and gentle exfoliant to thoroughly prepare your skin for active ingredients. Whilst your hydrating masque infuses enjoy a neck, arm and leg massage before eye balm and moisturiser are applied.

name: Deep tissue release (60 min)
description: Based on meridians and acupressure points this deeper therapeutic massage loosens muscle tissues, supports blood and oxygen circulation and releases stress, blockage and toxins. Beneficial for chronic pain, injuries or stubborn knots. You will be kneaded, pressed, stretched, elbowed and stroked into bliss.

name: Foot massage earthing (30 min)
description: Acupressure points on your feet correspond with body systems and can release blockages when stimulated. Sit back and relax whilst your therapist washes your feet then gives a soothing lower leg massage infused with foot reflexology to ground you and connect with mother earth.

name: Reiki infused surrender (90 min)
description: Beginning with Reiki to receive healing energy throughout your treatment. Reiki brings your therapist into their highest state and opens their heart to transmit good intentions and positive energy throughout your massage. Techniques used include Balinese, Swedish, deep tissue, lomi-lomi, shiatsu, and reiki. Ending with a head and face massage you are brought back to planet Earth and grounded with

name: Reiki chakra reset (30 min)
description: Chakras are the body’s energy centres that spin and distribute our prana / chi / essential life force. These centres get clogged up over time when we experience stress and negative emotions. We clear each of your 7 individual chakras, releasing blockage, then balance your key chakra centres in relation to their corresponding chakra. We also use coloured crystals over your chakras to amplify your h

name: Pedicure (60 min)
description: Pamper your feet so your toes and heels look and feel healthy. We begin with a foot scrub, then get down to the business of gently removing dry skin and callouses before trimming and shaping your nails. Your treatment includes a relaxing foot massage then we apply colour of your choice.

name: Hot stone soothe (90 min)
description: A gentle massage to remind us to slow down and remember we have a body. Warm volcanic stones are placed to warm and relax muscles, then long, slow strokes melt away stress and tension. Perfect to induce sleep, reduce anxiety, for arthritis / aching joints or those who prefer a more gentle, nurturing massage.

name: Shiatsu unfurl (60 min)
description: A strong massage based on Japanese healing systems release muscle and meridian blockages which cause pain physically, mentally and emotionally. Your therapist works deeply, without oil. Techniques used include acupressure with thumbs, palms, elbows, and the occasional foot! This style of massage can be fully clothed if you prefer.

name: Manicure (60 min)

name: Traditional balinese balance (60 min)

name: Magnesium Massage

name: Hot Stone Massage
description: Hot stone therapy is a powerful massage technique that involves heated riverbed stones. The effects of this ancient form of healing have been proven to release tension in muscles, increase blood circulation, trigger relaxation response in the nervous system and restore fluidity to the connective tissue joints. You will find it a wonderful alternative to your normal massage schedule.

name: Tension Release Massage
description: This massage combines Japanese Shiatsu palm pressing and pressure points along the energy meridian lines followed by a firm and deeply releasing oil massage to soothe sore and tired muscles.

name: Thai Massage
description: A Thai massage is more energizing and rigorous than other classic forms of massage. It is also known as the Thai Yoga massage, as the therapist will use her hands, knees, legs and feet to guide you into a series of yoga-like stretches.

name: Shiatsu Massage
description: A traditional Japanese finger pressure massage using slow, deep penetration of key points along the acupuncture meridians. The dispersing of excess or blocked energy can promote circulation to deficient areas of the body, stimulate the immune system and restore balance.

name: Pregnancy Massage

We finish off your treatment with a singing bowl.
